verdicts.reason: A breaks the text group: the quote mark sits far left, the quote is pushed to the centre, and the attribution floats between them on no shared edge. The quote is also small, the logo is a tiny speck, and the left and bottom of the canvas are dead space. B keeps the quote mark, quote and attribution as one left-aligned block that reads well, but the logo is blown up into a huge white bar across the top that outweighs the headline quote. That wrecks the hierarchy and the logo's proportion, and the long quote line runs close to the can.
